speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Singapore is facing new and complex challenges to our national security.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Our ability to respond to the multivariate threats is critical to ensure that we maintain our stability, cohesion and resilience.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Dealing with such challenges requires a coordinated response.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: These could range from new disruptive technologies to unintended consequences of existing developments.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: The work will draw from a wide range of experts in relevant fields, including academia.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: For instance, our critical infrastructure depends on different networks of utilities, information and people.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: Vulnerabilities in any one of these networks could have a far-reaching impact across sectors in the economy.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: This applies to many domains, such as energy, water, health, infocomm, banking and finance, and transport.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: The identification of these risks will also allow the Government to factor in such risks upfront in its long-term planning.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: To keep public officers up to date with the changing security environment, NSCS develops and conducts national security education programmes.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: We want to ensure that our officers in different Government agencies are aware of and sensitive to national security considerations and are able to translate these considerations into appropriate responses in their own policy domains.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: NSCS works with agencies and research institutes to understand trends and research related to violent extremism and shares these insights with a wide range of partners.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: These efforts have been useful, for example, in equipping frontline officers in non-security domains with the knowledge and skills to safeguard more vulnerable groups, like youths, against extremist messaging.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: National security is critical for the survival and prosperity of Singapore.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
text: The challenges in the coming years are complex.
